events.text_en: Hàm Thủ Lộ hangs the first mist lantern at the Trà Viên crossroads; travellers who walk under it are not seen until the next crossroads.
Vụ Ẩn Môn's founder hides a robber of Đoản Vĩ Cương from a Thúy Vi road patrol in his mist and does not ask why. The robber becomes his road guard.
Hàm Thủ Lộ walks into his own mist on the road by empty Đồng Sơn Trấn and is not found. His lantern is found on the road, still burning.
Robbers from the Ridge of the Bobtails fall on a caravan on the Đồng Sơn road. The guard Bối Trường Đình dies holding the mist over it, and one child lives.
An agent of Tùng Đào's first elder buys up a Phù Kiều gambler's debts in Hàn Tân Thành.
